name: dbx
description: 25 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 100+ databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, SQL Server, and Dameng. Built-in AI, MCP Server, CLI, desktop and Docker. Lightweight database management tool supporting 100+ databases with desktop, Docker, CLI, built-in AI assistant and MCP.
one_liner: A tiny, fast app for looking at and managing almost any type of database (MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, and 100+ others) with a built-in AI helper that can write queries for you.
buyer: A developer, data analyst, or IT admin who juggles multiple database types daily and is tired of paying for heavy, expensive database GUI tools.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer replaces a paid database GUI subscription with this free tool across every client project, saving licensing costs.
A data team standardizes on it company-wide since it works with all their different databases (Postgres, Mongo, Redis) in one lightweight app.
A support engineer uses the AI assistant to quickly write and debug SQL queries against unfamiliar client databases during support calls.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid team/enterprise tier with shared connection management, audit logs, and SSO for companies with many database users.
Sell premium AI query-assist credits for teams that want heavier AI usage beyond a free tier.

steal_this: This weekend, build a 'database health check' script on top of it that scans a company's databases for slow queries and missing indexes, then sell the report as a quick paid audit service to small dev shops.
